details.result: Exposed thin-ply intersections, shoulder wire contact, insufficient collar clearance and coarse placket tessellation. UV-aware welding in the verifier also needed correction.
Fixed-height emblem projection missed the shifted collar by several millimetres. Switched to neckline-derived emblem centres.
Body, sleeves, thickness and names pass. Remaining armhole thickness crossings, wire face crossings, collar attachment gap 3.473 mm and left board penetration 1.203 mm.

Four armhole-return crossings; hanger-tip crossings only; single-triangle tangent planes put button and medal rims outside their attachment band. Fit rigid discs to a sampled least-squares cloth plane.

details.result: All but the medal attachment pass. Medal gap 2.169 mm and penetration 0.727 mm. Reduce its nominal seating offset from 0.7 to 0.5 mm.

aging.result: Uniform 1.6 mm thickness opened medal, collar and button attachment gaps beyond 2 mm. Hole area and silhouette passed.
